import sys
import math

class Main:
    def main(self):
        in_data = sys.stdin.read().split()
        n = int(in_data[0])
        x = list(map(int, in_data[1:1+n]))
        y = list(map(int, in_data[1+n:1+2*n]))
        r = list(map(int, in_data[1+2*n:1+3*n]))
        circles = [Circle(Point(x[i], y[i]), r[i]) for i in range(n)]
        points = []
        for i in range(n):
            for j in range(i):
                intersect_points = circles[i].intersect(circles[j])
                if intersect_points is not None:
                    points.extend(intersect_points)
        bad = [False] * len(points)
        for i in range(len(points)):
            for j in range(i):
                if points[i] == points[j]:
                    bad[i] = True
                    break
        nVertices = ArrayUtils.count(bad, False)
        nEdges = 0
        setSystem = RecursiveIndependentSetSystem(len(points))
        index = 1 + 3 * n
        for i in range(n):
            current = 0
            onThis = []
            for j in range(len(points)):
                if not bad[j] and abs(circles[i].center.distance(points[j]) - r[i]) < GeometryUtils.epsilon:
                    current += 1
                    onThis.append(j)
            for j in range(1, len(onThis)):
                setSystem.join(onThis[j], onThis[0])
            nEdges += max(current, 1)
        nComponents = setSystem.getSetCount() - ArrayUtils.count(bad, True)
        print(1 + nEdges - nVertices + nComponents)

class Point:
    def __init__(self, x, y):
        self.x = x
        self.y = y

    def __eq__(self, other):
        return isinstance(other, Point) and abs(self.x - other.x) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon and abs(self.y - other.y) <= GeometryUtils.epsilon

    def __hash__(self):
        return hash((round(self.x / GeometryUtils.epsilon), round(self.y / GeometryUtils.epsilon)))

    def distance(self, other):
        return GeometryUtils.fastHypot(self.x - other.x, self.y - other.y)

class Line:
    def __init__(self, *args):
        if len(args) == 2:
            p, angle = args
            self.a = math.sin(angle)
            self.b = -math.cos(angle)
            self.c = -p.x * self.a - p.y * self.b
        elif len(args) == 3:
            a, b, c = args
            h = GeometryUtils.fastHypot(a, b)
            self.a = a / h
            self.b = b / h
            self.c = c / h

    def intersect(self, other):
        if self.parallel(other):
            return None
        determinant = self.b * other.a - self.a * other.b
        x = (self.c * other.b - self.b * other.c) / determinant
        y = (self.a * other.c - self.c * other.a) / determinant
        return Point(x, y)

    def parallel(self, other):
        return abs(self.a * other.b - self.b * other.a) < GeometryUtils.epsilon

    def perpendicular(self, point):
        return Line(-self.b, self.a, self.b * point.x - self.a * point.y)

    def value(self, point):
        return self.a * point.x + self.b * point.y + self.c

    def intersect_circle(self, circle):
        distance = self.distance(circle.center)
        if distance > circle.radius + GeometryUtils.epsilon:
            return []
        intersection_point = self.perpendicular(circle.center).intersect(self)
        if abs(distance - circle.radius) < GeometryUtils.epsilon:
            return [intersection_point]
        shift = math.sqrt(circle.radius * circle.radius - distance * distance)
        return [Point(intersection_point.x + shift * self.b, intersection_point.y - shift * self.a),
                Point(intersection_point.x - shift * self.b, intersection_point.y + shift * self.a)]

    def distance(self, point):
        return abs(self.value(point))

class Circle:
    def __init__(self, center, radius):
        self.center = center
        self.radius = radius

    def intersect(self, other):
        distance = self.center.distance(other.center)
        if distance < GeometryUtils.epsilon:
            return None
        line = Line(2 * (other.center.x - self.center.x),
                    2 * (other.center.y - self.center.y),
                    other.radius * other.radius - self.radius * self.radius + self.center.x * self.center.x - other.center.x * other.center.x + self.center.y * self.center.y - other.center.y * other.center.y)
        return line.intersect_circle(self)

class ArrayUtils:
    @staticmethod
    def count(array, value):
        return sum(1 for i in array if i == value)

class GeometryUtils:
    epsilon = 1e-8

    @staticmethod
    def fastHypot(x, y):
        return math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)

class RecursiveIndependentSetSystem:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.color = list(range(size))
        self.rank = [0] * size
        self.setCount = size
        self.listener = None

    def join(self, first, second):
        first = self.get(first)
        second = self.get(second)
        if first == second:
            return False
        if self.rank[first] < self.rank[second]:
            first, second = second, first
        elif self.rank[first] == self.rank[second]:
            self.rank[first] += 1
        self.setCount -= 1
        self.color[second] = first
        if self.listener:
            self.listener.joined(second, first)
        return True

    def get(self, index):
        start = index
        while self.color[index] != index:
            index = self.color[index]
        while start != index:
            next_idx = self.color[start]
            self.color[start] = index
            start = next_idx
        return index

    def getSetCount(self):
        return self.setCount

if __name__ == "__main__":
    Main().main()
